content.title: Inside the Hurley family tree: How brothers Dan and Bobby are following in dad Bob Sr.'s coaching footsteps
content.text: Dan Hurley, Bobby HurleyInside the Hurley family tree: How brothers Dan and Bobby are following in dad Bob Sr.'s coaching footsteps originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.AdvertisementJUMP TO: Is Dan Hurley related to Bobby Hurley?Who is Bob Hurley Sr.?Dan Hurley family treeBobby Hurley family treeBobby Hurley accidentWho is the Hurley brothers' mom?Do the Hurley brothers have other siblings?Where are the Hurleys from?Only 17 head coaches in college basketball have won national championships, so Dan Hurley is in excellent company regardless of what he does for the rest of his career.Hurley is the most successful coach in his family when considering level, but he isn’t the only one. His brother is also a longtime collegiate head coach, and both credit their father for getting them where they are today professionally..The bond the Hurley brothers and the rest of their family share continues to be on display with each UConn run in the NCAA Tournament.Here’s what you need to know about the Hurley family tree.AdvertisementMORE:Most March Madness wins ever, by coachIs Dan Hurley related to Bobby Hurley?Dan Hurley is indeed related to Bobby Hurley. Bobby came to prominence long before his brother, as he was a two-time national champion and 1992–93 All-American at Duke before a five-year NBA career. But it’s Dan who has found the most success in the coaching ranks, with a pair of national titles at UConn.Are Dan and Bobby Hurley twins?The Hurley brothers aren't twins, but they aren't separated by much. Bobby was born in June of 1971, while Dan was born 19 months later in January of 1973.MORE:Who has the most 3s in a March Madness game?AdvertisementWho is Bob Hurley Sr.?The Hurley brothers are prominent names today, but their father set the standard.Bob Hurley Sr. is one of the most successful high school coaches in basketball history, having served as head coach at St. Anthony High School for 45 seasons from 1972 to 2017. He won 26 state championships and became the third high school coach elected to the Basketball Hall of Fame when he received an orange jacket in 2010.Bob’s run included five undefeated seasons, six NBA first-round picks, and reportedly many job offers at the college level that he turned down. His tenure at St. Anthony only ended when the school closed in 2017.AdvertisementBoth Hurley brothers played for their father. Now in retirement, Bob watches with pride as his sons lead major basketball programs on opposite sides of the country.MORE: Most March Madness wins all time, by schoolDan Hurley has a wife and two sons. Here's what you need to know about them.Dan Hurley wife: Andrea HurleyMore prominent at UConn games than perhaps anyone connected to Hurley is his wife, Andrea, who earned camera time during the Huskies' title runs in 2023 and 2024. Dan and Andrea married in 1997, and photos from that point in their relationship show the UConn coach with much more hair than he has today.While Andrea has said she has "zero interest" in basketball herself, she briefly co-hosted a podcast named "Ball Is Wife" to give the perspective of wives and girlfriends in sports. Andrea has also said the players are her favorite part of her husband's profession.AdvertisementHow did Dan Hurley meet his wife?The Hurleys met while they were both students at Seton Hall."I met her at Seton Hall. It's like, by far, the best thing that happened to me at Seton Hall, but that was the thing that saved my life when I met her," Hurley told WTNH in 2023. He explained that Andrea made him "want to be better."Andrea, meanwhile, said she didn't know Dan was an athlete or of the prominence of his family at the time.MORE: What is a Cinderella in March Madness?Dan Hurley son: Danny HurleyDanny Hurley is the Hurleys' oldest son. Born in 1999, Danny followed his father's path and graduated from Seton Hall in 2021, where he majored in history.AdvertisementDanny pursued a political career, as he has served as an aide to former New Jersey Gov. Phil Murphy and New Jersey senate president Nicholas Scutari.Dan Hurley son: Andrew HurleyHurley's youngest son, Andrew, played under his father for four seasons at UConn, finishing his career with back-to-back national championships. Andrew didn't hold a regular role with the Huskies, receiving a total of 63 minutes across his four seasons in Storrs, but he became a fan favorite and was able to close out some games in 2023 and 2024 with the numerous blowouts UConn engineered on its way to titles.Andrew told CT Insider that he doesn't plan to follow his father into the coaching ranks but would be open to a general manager role as more college basketball programs hire executives to manage roster-building.AdvertisementMORE:Why Bill Murray is a UConn fanBobby Hurley family treeBobby Hurley is married and has three children.Bobby Hurley wife: Leslie HurleyHurley met his wife, Leslie, a few months after his 1993 accident. She said after Hurley's hiring at Arizona State that she rebounded for him in the months after they met, helping him train while he recovered from major injuries.Bobby Hurley daughters: Cameron and Sydney HurleyHurley and his wife have two daughters, Cameron and Sydney. Cameron, like her father, graduated from Duke, while less is known about Sydney.Bobby Hurley son: Bobby Hurley IIIHurley's only son, Bobby III, spent four seasons on Arizona State's basketball team under his father. He played only 82 minutes across his career and graduated in 2025.AdvertisementBobby Hurley accidentJust as he was trying to become an NBA star in his rookie season, Hurley’s career and life were derailed by a serious car accident in 1993. Hurley was thrown 100 feet from his car after colliding with a vehicle that didn’t have its headlights on, resulting in broken ribs, a pair of collapsed lungs, a severed trachea, a fracture in his back and a torn ACL, among other injuries.Hurley did return to the NBA, but he struggled to be the player he wanted to be and spent only five seasons in the league. After his playing career, Hurley struggled to figure out what he wanted to do next. His brother’s coaching career helped open doors, as Bobby became an assistant on Dan’s staffs at Wagner and Rhode Island before landing his first head coaching job at Buffalo."He has a purpose now, and it's not just about him," Leslie said of her husband after he was hired by Arizona State, where he spent 11 seasons.AdvertisementMORE:How Bobby Hurley's NCAA assist record was surpassedWho is the Hurley brothers' mom?The Hurleys' mother, Christine, has long been married to Bob Sr. and served as a scorekeeper for many of her husband's games during his time as a high school coach. Christine generally stays out of the spotlight, but Andy Katz caught up to her and Bob Sr. after UConn won the national championship in 2023, with Christine explaining how proud she was of her son.Christine was back in the spotlight in 2026, when cameras captured her hilarious reaction to Braylon Mullins' game-winning shot in the Elite Eight. Christine could be seen screaming "Holy f— s—!" when Mullins' shot went down."I've had people come up to me and say I've known you for 20 years. I've never heard you curse," Christine joked in the days after the win.AdvertisementDo the Hurley brothers have other siblings?Dan and Bobby have one sister, Melissa, who largely keeps her life private. Dan also revealed earlier in his career that he had a younger brother named Sean who died as a young child. "The death of my — we had a younger brother, who was born after me and before my youngest sister, Melissa. Sean, who died very young," Dan said when asked about some of the toughest moments of his life outside of basketball.Where are the Hurleys from?The Hurleys are New Jerseyans through-and-through. Bob Sr., Bobby and Dan were all born in Jersey City and grew up in New Jersey. Bobby's basketball prowess took him to Durham, where he starred at Duke, but Dan stayed local for college, playing in-state at Seton Hall.AdvertisementThe Hurleys may have most of their fans in Connecticut and the surrounding areas today, but their roots tie them back to New Jersey.
